title: Peach Aviation reportedly says 延べ最大約944万件 of records leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
date_note: The page gives Peach's 26 November notice date; its own post is dated 27 November.
geo_basis: country as stated; the page read does not name a city
summary: Rocket Boys and ITmedia report Peach Aviation disclosed on 26 November that customer data held in PLAID KARTE was leaked, 延べ最大約944万件 (a cumulative record count, not a count of people). ITmedia says the data remained after the contract ended because of Plaid management deficiencies; Plaid was then hit by unauthorized access. Listed items are name, date of birth, postal code, address, phone number and email address; ITmedia says no card or passport data.
plain: Peach Aviation reportedly says customer data kept in a marketing contractor service leaked, 延べ最大約944万件 (a cumulative record count, not a count of people). ITmedia says the data should have been deleted after the contract ended.
exec: Reports say 延べ最大約944万件 of Peach Aviation customer records leaked via a contractor service; no misuse had been confirmed as of 26 November, per Rocket Boys.
action: Peach says it will contact affected customers individually and set up an inquiry desk, per ITmedia NEWS; otherwise no action needed; for awareness.

sources.name: Rocket Boys Security Measures Lab (relays Peach's 26 November notice; the notice itself could not be loaded)

evidence.quote: 漏えい対象は延べ最大約944万件です。
最大約944万件という数字はデータの延べ件数であり、944万人の漏えいを確認したという意味ではありません。

validation.note: Rocket Boys and ITmedia NEWS (two publishers) each relay Peach's 26 November notice and state the 延べ最大約944万件 figure; Peach's own notice could not be loaded.

review.note: figure qualifier: removed English about/up-to-about wording, kept the source's 延べ最大約944万件 in title and summary; data items and no-misuse date match Rocket Boys
